unit: relative evidence contribution to an actor-specific interpretation; not a psychometric score, gameplay delta API or closeness threshold
rules: Ranges illustrate scale, not random draws to apply blindly.
0 means no assumed standing change, not absent interaction/memory.
Commitment is primarily an explicit relationship/obligation record, not a cumulative points bonus.
Deduplicate by canonical episode and relevant evidence; maintained is not automatically strengthened.
Allow dispositions/context to change appraisal without making consent or trust compulsory.
Do not sum all dimensions into one friendship bucket.

rows.boundary: Record contact and any temporary appraisal, not default standing warmth/trust points merely from repetition.

rows.conduct: Agreeing to a specific feasible request
rows.boundary: Create the commitment; anticipation can be a temporary appraisal, not fulfillment.
Ground recipient interpretation in need, cost and consent; no automatic reciprocal duty.
Domain-specific reliance; competence does not guarantee affection.
Evaluate the actual terms and capacity; same promise counted once.
May change appraisal or issue respect; not universally a strained relationship.
Record the response; disappointment may exist without standing penalty.

rows.conduct: Unexplained avoidable breach of meaningful commitment
rows.boundary: Causal alternatives/capacity matter; accident or unknowable obligation is not deliberate betrayal.

rows.conduct: Known deliberate deception or privacy breach
rows.boundary: Undiscovered act does not reveal itself; lie differs from sincere mistake.
Reduced tension is not erased breach or instantly restored trust.

rows.conduct: Ongoing meaningful support under an accepted arrangement
rows.boundary: Aggregate related daily work as one evolving episode rather than 365 independent bonuses.
